title: Phase 55P adds six Published-evidence reader pathways
summary: FTFN connected the current Published corpus into six curated reader journeys across chips and compute, energy and grid capacity, critical minerals, policy and standards, advanced manufacturing, and local conversion in the U.S. Southwest and Ontario. Each pathway states the supported current condition, separates the dependency stages, exposes evidence limits, and names the next authoritative records needed.
evidence_note: Every pathway is anchored to Published signals, Published briefings, Published dependency maps, and Published research collections. Open local and implementation stages remain linked to evidence-gap records and are not promoted into outcome claims.
